title: 28" to 48" tension rod.
text: 28" to 48" tension rod.. bought these to hand some Japanese norens I purchased - one for a window, one for a doorway...  Strong... holds nicely in place, yet easy to move when you need to. Twist to lengthen - easy- yet sturdy in place. They are perfect as they are skinny - not to thick.  I would definitely purchase again.  I will of course update my reviews should new info seem useful.

description: From Levolor, this 7/16-Inch Tension Rod is perfect for lightweight draperies or curtains, sheers, or valances. Soft plastic tips will not mark or damage mounting surface. White. Telescoping rod ranges from 28 to 48 inches. Easy installation--and no holes in your wall. Since the early 1900's Levolor has been setting the standard in window fashions, design innovation, product quality and customer satisfaction. Levolor remains the most recognized name in custom window coverings today. Levolor continues to offer great blinds and shades solutions in a wide variety of vertical, aluminum and wood blinds; cellular and woven wood shades; and sheer vertical window treatments. Levolor has expanded its product offering to include beautiful decorative drapery hardware, distributed nationally through home centers and other retailers.
